data_objects.name: weather_observations
data_objects.meaning: Timestamped city weather observations containing temperature, humidity, pressure, a textual condition, wind measurements, and a distance-like attribute.
data_objects.notes: Two timestamp representations are provided for each observation, together with an exported row index.

variables.name: temp
variables.meaning: Air-temperature measurement; the scale is not stated.

variables.name: description
variables.meaning: Categorical natural-language description of weather conditions.

variables.name: dt
variables.meaning: Unix-like numeric timestamp for the observation.

variables.name: wind_deg
variables.meaning: Wind direction expressed as an angular bearing.

variables.name: city
variables.meaning: City associated with the weather observation.

variables.name: day
variables.meaning: Human-readable local-looking date and time paired with dt.

variables.name: dist
variables.meaning: Distance-like numeric attribute; its reference location and unit are not defined.

structure.description: Each row is one city-time weather observation; city together with dt is the natural candidate key, while the exported index preserves source order.
dt and day are aligned timestamp representations but use different apparent time conventions; rows are ordered chronologically.

uncertainties: Temperature scale, humidity convention, pressure unit, wind-speed unit, and the meaning and unit of dist are not declared.
The timezone relationship between dt and day is not documented.
annotation_notes: Only the declared neutral train.csv was used; uncertain measurement metadata is not guessed.
